original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract, not another mixture already covered by the frozen catalogue.

first_step.inspect: Read the frozen catalogue bound exclusions and select one genuinely different helper endpoint inventory.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write the complete optimistic child histogram and reject it immediately if even the relaxation has insufficient headroom.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Helper inventory changes can improve the moment; repacking a covered cost interface cannot evade its scoped bound.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: In the PR942 shared pool, replace all 122 U8 width-8 helpers by width-6 helpers, delete exactly two rank-1 children per replacement, and price width 6 at the unique most negative six-unit fill marginal on capacities at most 48. Does this optimistic dual relaxation reach primitive saving 1/99?
scope_change_reason: The card allows one explicit helper type. Width 6 is absent from every frozen catalogue interface. The screen uses one uniform replacement count, 122, and one price, -39. It is not a mixture of the 25 pinned interfaces.
bottleneck_link: The complex primitive binds. This width is outside the frozen helper alphabet, so the catalogue mixture bound does not price it. The fully charged relaxation still has saving below 1/500, which is below the retained 1/99 planning threshold for kappa above 1/100.
stop_rule: Stop when both moment engines certify the relaxation root below 1/500. Do not search for a scalar program of this same rewrite after that obstruction.
evidence: PASS_U8_WIDTH6_NA_SCREEN. Both engines give moment below 1 at 1821649025053055110577/10^24 and above 1 at the next 10^-24 tick. Moment remains below 1 at the U8 successor tick 1664727258740678855773/10^24 and is above 1 at 1/500 and at 1/99.
author: donated research session

open_questions.question: Can a proper subset of the 122 width-8 helpers be shrunk inside the pinned U8 scalar program so a hosted invoice, not only this dual lower bound, is strictly below 1 at 1664727258740678855773/10^24?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The screen leaves a gap between the U8 root and 1821649025053055110578/10^24. A hosted invoice inside that gap would be a real complex-side improvement. The same full rewrite cannot reach 1/99 under the stated price and mass hypotheses, so further effort on this rewrite should aim at that gap or stop.
open_questions.first_step: Shrink one width-8 helper in the pinned U8 word to width 6, delete exactly two rank-1 children, restore arbitrary dirty state, and evaluate the resulting one-call histogram in this same dual.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package contains no scalar program that performs the deletion. A signed price below -39 needs a credit rule other than the old fill marginals; that rule is outside the screen.
